ORIGIN.quote: Attribution therefore requires behavior and context rather than interpreting names such as “OpenAI” as verified provenance.
ORIGIN.reason: A reader learns only that OpenAI-bearing labels appear in the data and that the report explicitly declines to treat them as evidence of who ran the swarm, reinforced later by "They do not warrant claiming a particular model vendor"; the possibility is raised solely to be set aside. That refusal framing puts it above the 0.2 band (the connection to provenance is made by the report, not left to the reader) but below 0.6, since OpenAI is never left standing as a live candidate operator.
